lines: Chupke chupke raat din aansoo bahana yaad hai
couplets.en: I remember weeping in secret, night and day.

lines: Humko ab tak aashiqi ka woh zamana yaad hai
Chupke chupke raat din aansoo bahana yaad hai
couplets.en: I still remember those days of love, and how I wept in secret, night and day.

lines: Tujh se milte hi woh kuchh bebaak ho jaana mera
couplets.en: I remember how bold I grew the moment we met.

lines: Tujh se milte hi woh kuchh bebaak ho jaana mera
Aur tera daanton mein woh ungli dabana yaad hai
couplets.en: I remember how bold I grew when we met, and how you pressed a finger between your teeth.

lines: Humko ab tak aashiqi ka woh zamana yaad hai
Chupke chupke raat din aansoo bahana yaad hai
couplets.en: I still remember those days of love, and how I wept in secret, night and day.

lines: Chori chori hum se tum aa kar mile the jis jagah
Muddatein guzriin par ab tak woh thikana yaad hai
couplets.en: Years have passed, yet I still remember the place where you came to meet me in secret.

lines: Humko ab tak aashiqi ka woh zamana yaad hai
Chupke chupke raat din aansoo bahana yaad hai
couplets.en: I still remember those days of love, and how I wept in secret, night and day.

lines: Kheench lena woh mera parde ka kona dafaatan
couplets.en: I remember how suddenly I tugged at the corner of the curtain.

lines: Kheench lena woh mera parde ka kona dafaatan
Aur dupatte se tera woh munh chhupana yaad hai
couplets.en: I remember tugging suddenly at the corner of the curtain, and how you hid your face in your dupatta.

lines: Humko ab tak aashiqi ka woh zamana yaad hai
Chupke chupke raat din aansoo bahana yaad hai
couplets.en: I still remember those days of love, and how I wept in secret, night and day.

lines: Dopahar ki dhoop mein mere bulane ke liye
couplets.en: It was in the midday sun that you came to call me.

lines: Dopahar ki dhoop mein mere bulane ke liye
Woh tera kothe pe nange paon aana yaad hai
couplets.en: I remember you coming barefoot onto the roof in the midday sun to call me.
